OUTSIDE THE CHAMBER — the dry side
CHAMBER WALL — 7/8 in. grommet / tent cable port
power strip, 12 V supply, chargers, Pi, smart plugs and both switch boards
sensors, cameras, scale, door contact and 12 V loads only
USB-A → micro-USB, 6 ft (2 m) → cam-01's ESP32-CAM-MB
USB-A → micro-USB, 6 ft (2 m) → cam-02's ESP32-CAM-MB
USB-A → USB-C, 6 ft (2 m) → climate-01 (shelf A)
USB-A → USB-C, 6 ft (2 m) → climate-02 (shelf B)
cam-01 · ESP32-CAM on its ESP32-CAM-MB · OV2640 or OV3660 · front view
cam_mount · no GPIO wiring · flash LED (GPIO 4) · substrate level, angled slightly up
cam-02 · ESP32-CAM on its ESP32-CAM-MB · OV2640 or OV3660 · top-down
cam_mount · looking straight down, 15-30 cm from the substrate
4397 → SHT31-D, 4210 → SCD41, 4210 → BH1750 · sensor_mount, substrate level
4397 → SHT31-D, 4210 → SCD41, 4210 → BH1750 · sensor_mount, substrate level
relay_board_mount, node="relay" — 4 switch channels (UF4007 on each) + HX711 + door contact
↑ 22 AWG 4-conductor → HX711: red 3V3 → VCC, black GND, yellow DOUT → 32, white SCK → 33
↑ second 22 AWG 4-conductor run (2 used) → door contact: COM → GPIO 35, alarm NC → GND
100R gate · 10K pull-down · IRLZ44N · UF4007 across J2
UF4007 across the pump · 60 s max-on
ESP32 GND → J1 − → GND bus (both boards)
fresh-air intake at the wall · fan_duct
Peristaltic pump — Adafruit 1150 12 V, in pump_bracket (new in Tier 3)
18 AWG red/black leads · food-grade silicone tubing (2 × 4 mm) to the substrate
Fans: bundled 30 cm extension + Noctua NA-SEC3 (cut its far end): GND → J2 −, +12 V → J2 +
by pin position, not colour; tach + PWM unused. Pump: 18 AWG red/black, red → J2 +, black → J2 −.
HX711 (Adafruit 5974) + 5 kg cell (4541) in hx711_scale, under the grow block
22/4 cable: red VCC · black GND · yellow DOUT · white SCK · cell red E+, black E− · 10 SPS
Door contact (weideer MC-31B) on the door frame, magnet on the door
COM → GPIO 35, alarm NC → GND (closed = door shut) · wired on NO? tick invert (reed_inv)
no diodes — LED strips are resistive
White 6500K LED strip — JOYLIT 5 m roll, cut to closet length
red → J2 +, black → J2 − (18 AWG red/black pair)
GREEN wire (730 nm far-red) → CH3 J2 −

g.text: MQTT over WiFi — no wires from the Pi to any node or plug

svg.text: Plugs: User sp-3p, Topic = role, Full Topic tasmota/%topic%/%prefix%/ (required)
Peltier cooler at the chamber wall
plug-cooler (Topic cooler) · plugs #2 + #4 are new in Tier 3
One switch-board channel, end to end — CH3 aux (peristaltic pump) on relay_board_mount
Every relay and lighting channel is this circuit; fans use a 4-pin PWM extension lead instead, and the lighting board leaves out the UF4007.
COMMON GROUND: ESP32 GND → J1 − → GND bus → WAGO 221-415 → PSU −. Leave it out and the gate has no reference — the channel never switches. Do it on both boards.
RED = +12 V (and 3V3 on the QT cable)
PURPLE = new in Tier 3 (HX711 / reed signals)
Wire: 14 AWG pigtail · 18 AWG red/black for every 12 V run (strips, pump) · 22 AWG hookup
or Dupont for GPIO / GND → J1 · 22 AWG 4-conductor for the HX711 + reed. Heat-shrink splices.
12 V branches and fuses (inline blade fuse on each +12 V branch)
Relay board: 3 A — three fans + the pump stay under ~1 A.
Lighting board: 7.5 A — the strips are the load. GND branches are not fused.
12V 10A PSU: keep the total ≤ ~8 A — cut the strips to closet length.
Strip (12 + 2 USB-A): Pi PSU, 12 V PSU, 6 chargers, 4 plugs.
221-413 → inline 3 A fuse → relay +12 V bus (18 AWG red).
221-413 → inline 7.5 A fuse → lighting +12 V bus (18 AWG red).
221-415 → both boards' GND bus (18 AWG black).
ESP32 GND → J1 − on both boards: the COMMON GROUND.
GPIO → Dupont → J1 IN → 100R → gate; 10K gate → source.
Drain → J2 −; J2 + → +12 V bus; UF4007 on relay channels.
Fans: NA-SEC3 extension, far end cut — GND → J2 −, +12 V → J2 +.
Pump on CH3 aux (GPIO 14): 18 AWG, UF4007 across it.
Strips: 18 AWG red/black. BLUE wire → CH1, RED → CH2,
GREEN (730 nm) → CH3, common wire → +12 V.
22/4: red 3V3 → VCC, black GND, yellow DOUT → 32, white SCK → 33.
22 AWG 4-conductor (2 used): COM → GPIO 35, alarm NC → GND.
EXTERNAL 10K pull-up GPIO 35 → 3V3 (no internal pull on 34-39).
Wired on NO? Tick the portal's invert box (reed_inv).
Tick HX711 + door reed under Optional peripherals.
Cell red → E+, black → E−; tare, then calibrate once.
Each climate node: 4397 on 3V3 / GND / GPIO 21 / GPIO 22,
climate-01/02 + cam-01/02: 6 ft (2 m) USB through the grommet.
Relay + lighting ESP32s stay outside on short cables.
WiFi only, sp-3p + Full Topic (see the build guide).
ESP32-S3 boards use other pins: build guide §8a.
